comment: wintty.c tty_clear_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE) repairs with docorner() the rows a wrapped top line reached (cw->cury). A Knight riding a pony with a long horsename gets a getpos autodescribe longer than the terminal, which show_topl()'s addtopl() wraps onto row 1. Travel to her own square says only a MSGTYPE-hidden "You are already here.", so the description stays until cmd.c parse() clears the message window before ^G's prompt, erasing row 1. Seed, date, character and inputs chosen independently.

segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Wrapper,role:Knight,race:human,gender:female,align:lawful,playmode:debug,!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,!autopickup,autodescribe
OPTIONS=horsename:Bartholomew Longshanks of the Northern Downs
MSGTYPE=hide "already here"
